name: manifest-segment-header-mismatch
description: A correctly signed manifest whose capture segment header carries a different assignment_id.
asserts: The manifest signature, content root and member digests are all valid; the segment is simply not the one the manifest describes. Verification of members against the manifest must fail on assignment_id. A valid signature binds the manifest to the device key, not the manifest to its segments: that is this check's job.
